-- script --
option filters kinds
option layout columns
start /home/evan
size 90 12
note a click on the footer's chip opens the menu
click 85 11
state menu true
snapshot open
note a click on a row checks it; the menu stays open and the columns follow
click 75 5
state types Documents
snapshot documents
click 75 6
state types Documents,Data
note a click outside closes it, and does no more
click 5 6
state menu false
state types Documents,Data
snapshot closed
note a folder with nothing of the chosen kinds says so
press enter
state dir /home/evan/docs
press ctrl+f
click 75 3
click 75 4
press esc
state types Pictures
snapshot none-here
press ctrl+f
click 75 3
state types ""
